item.title: Infant allegedly assaulted by mother in remote community
item.description: An infant was taken to hospital in Alice Springs Sunday night after allegedly being assaulted by her 20-year-old mother in a remote MacDonnell Region community, NT Police said, while an investigation into the matter is currently ongoing.

item.title: Bullying allegations against CLP MLA a ‘sensitive HR matter’ that needs to be kept quiet, Chief Minister claims
item.description: Bullying allegations against CLP MLA Tanzil Rahman made by two female parliamentary staffers have "been resolved" as part of a "sensitive HR matter", Chief Minister Lia Finocchiaro has claimed, but questions remain over how the situation was handled and what the Chief Minister knew about the allegations.

item.title: NT Criminal Court list – with charges – Feb 19
item.description: The 278 names facing criminal courts in the Northern Territory for Thursday, February 19, 2026. This list includes all the charges.

item.title: CDU’s TAFE bungle now affecting roughly 400 former students who weren’t properly qualified
item.description: A growing scandal at Charles Darwin University that saw it graduate an estimated 130 carpentry apprenticeship students without the proper qualifications is now estimated to affect "an additional 250 students" who may have to resit their qualifications in other areas, with the number expected to rise to potentially thousands of students, the NT Independent understands.

item.title: Anindilyakwa Land Council appoints Kupa Teao as CEO
item.description: New Zealander Kupa Teao has been started as the new chief executive officer of the troubled Anindilyakwa Land Council which was under investigation by the National Anti-Corruption Commission.

item.title: NTEC says ‘no evidence’ Styles returned his political donations on time
item.description: There is "no evidence to substantiate" Darwin Mayor Peter Styles' claims that he returned his mayoral campaign donation list in person before the deadline for disclosures lapsed, the NT Electoral Commission has said, following an internal review.

item.title: Darwin man charged with alleged $5 million NDIS fraud
item.description: A 47-year-old Darwin man has been arrested by the AFP following a months-long investigation into allegations he exploited his position as a federal public servant to defraud the National Disability Insurance Scheme by directing vulnerable individuals to an NDIS provider he co-owns.

item.title: ‘You can’t hide forever’: Calls mount for CLP MLA to publicly explain bullying allegations
item.description: CLP backbencher Tanzil Rahman needs to publicly explain the bullying allegations that were levelled against him by two female parliamentary staffers, independent MLAs and the Opposition have said, which follows the Chief Minister's attempts to keep the "sensitive HR matter" secret, which she claimed was "out of respect for all parties", despite the matter already being resolved.

item.title: Bowman’s ‘head must roll’ over CDU TAFE stuff-up, federal inquiry held: MLA
item.description: A federal inquiry into Charles Darwin University's governance practices and general "competency" should be ordered immediately and vice-chancellor Scott Bowman's "head must roll", an independent MLA has said, in the wake of revelations nearly 400 CDU TAFE students and others were graduated without proper qualifications.

item.title: Calls for Police Commissioner to explain why executive team is under investigation by the AFP
item.description: Territory police officers want to know why the entire NT Police top brass is currently under investigation by the Australian Federal Police, the union representing the cops has said, while questions about perceived conflicts of interest in the investigation have been ignored by all involved.
